diagnostics.message:
@AddMonoidAlgebra.infDegree : {R : Type u_1} →
  {A : Type u_2} →
    {T : Type u_3} →
      [inst : Semiring R] → [inst_1 : SemilatticeInf T] → [OrderTop T] → (A → T) → AddMonoidAlgebra R A → T

@AddMonoidAlgebra.le_infDegree_mul : ∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} {T : Type u_3} [inst : Semiring R]
  [inst_1 : SemilatticeInf T] [inst_2 : OrderTop T] [inst_3 : AddZeroClass A] [inst_4 : Add T] [AddLeftMono T]
  [AddRightMono T] (D : A →ₙ+ T) (f g : AddMonoidAlgebra R A),
  AddMonoidAlgebra.infDegree (⇑D) f + AddMonoidAlgebra.infDegree (⇑D) g ≤ AddMonoidAlgebra.infDegree (⇑D) (f * g)

@AddMonoidAlgebra.le_inf_support_finset_prod : ∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} {T : Type u_3} {ι : Type u_4}
  [inst : SemilatticeInf T] [inst_1 : OrderTop T] [inst_2 : CommSemiring R] [inst_3 : AddCommMonoid A]
  [inst_4 : AddCommMonoid T] [AddLeftMono T] [AddRightMono T] {degt : A → T},
  0 ≤ degt 0 →
    (∀ (a b : A), degt a + degt b ≤ degt (a + b)) →
      ∀ (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → AddMonoidAlgebra R A),
        ∑ i ∈ s, (f i).coeff.support.inf degt ≤ (∏ i ∈ s, f i).coeff.support.inf degt

@MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder_neg : ∀ {σ : Type u_1} (w : σ → ℕ) {R : Type u_2} [inst : Ring R] (f : MvPowerSeries σ R),
  MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w (-f) = MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w f
